description: Three connected areas: 47 capabilities, three area nodes and one engineering hub. Evidence includes reviewed public and private implementation; private projects link through portfolio descriptions.

nodes.label: Web & mobile systems
nodes.detail: Business applications, custom CMSs and mobile tools that connect interfaces, records and backend services.

nodes.label: React & Next.js
nodes.detail: Component-based React interfaces and broader Next.js web-project experience.

nodes.label: Node.js APIs
nodes.detail: Firebase Cloud Functions and Fastify services with typed contracts, validation and application-data boundaries.

nodes.label: TypeScript
nodes.detail: Typed domain models, component contracts, state transitions and service boundaries.

nodes.label: Firebase & Firestore
nodes.detail: Authentication, document storage, queries and Cloud Functions for application workflows.

nodes.label: Custom CMSs
nodes.detail: Product, article and media administration, rich-text editors, draft and publication workflows, staff access and reusable content models.

nodes.label: Auth & roles
nodes.detail: Staff provisioning, custom claims and backend permission checks distinguish administration from content editing.

nodes.label: Content modelling
nodes.detail: Structured product, article, guide, campaign and settings records with validation, metadata and links between entities.

nodes.label: Data validation
nodes.detail: Form and import validation, enquiry rate limits, stale-write checks and partial-failure handling in bulk operations.

nodes.label: Offline sync
nodes.detail: SQLite records with durable pending uploads, stable identifiers, dependency-aware retries and visible correction conflicts.

nodes.label: Application state
nodes.detail: Form state, query-cache updates, loading/error states and browser-tab cache coordination keep interfaces consistent with changing data.

nodes.label: React Native & Expo
nodes.detail: Mobile field-record interfaces, local persistence and forecast views in an Android-first agronomy application in development.

nodes.label: Analytics & reporting
nodes.detail: Application reporting and strategy-game dashboards combine recorded events, historical snapshots, comparisons and interactive D3 charts.

nodes.label: Media libraries
nodes.detail: Reusable asset selection and uploads, image compression, WebP thumbnails, alt text and reference-aware deletion.

nodes.label: SSR & caching
nodes.detail: Server rendering, route prefetching, query-cache hydration and invalidation after content changes.

nodes.label: Data import & export
nodes.detail: Spreadsheet imports, structured exports and partial-record updates, with validation and per-record feedback for bulk operations.

nodes.label: Accessible & responsive UI
nodes.detail: Keyboard interaction, focus management, status announcements and responsive layouts across public sites and application tools.

nodes.label: Internationalisation
nodes.detail: Localised static pages, right-to-left presentation, locale-aware number parsing and numeral formatting; responsive layouts support different devices.

nodes.label: ML & research engineering
nodes.detail: Applied speech and image processing alongside independent neural-model, learned-memory and GPU execution research.

nodes.label: Python
nodes.detail: Model research, experiment tooling and document-processing pipelines with PDF extraction, OCR and speech-model integration.

nodes.label: C++ & CUDA
nodes.detail: Native PyTorch extensions and GPU kernels for recurrent-state computation and training gradients.

nodes.label: PyTorch
nodes.detail: Trainable modules, optimisers, tensor operations and custom execution paths for neural models.

nodes.label: Triton
nodes.detail: GPU kernels for structured scans and selected-state memory updates, including a separate fused inference path.

nodes.label: Neural architectures
nodes.detail: Experimental state-space and recurrent language models, with structured memory and geometric layers.

nodes.label: ML compiler systems
nodes.detail: Model-specific execution planning and dispatch: typed plans select eager or GPU paths using tensor shape, precision, algebraic constraints and hardware profiles.

nodes.label: Memory & retrieval
nodes.detail: Learned addressing, hard/soft routing, delta updates and hierarchical memory; retrieval quality is measured separately from kernel cost.

nodes.label: Parallel scans
nodes.detail: Associative transition composition and ordered parallel-prefix algorithms for recurrent state updates.

nodes.label: Geometric ML
nodes.detail: Equivariant operators, group representations and geometric algebra inform structured neural layers and controlled learning experiments.

nodes.label: Custom autograd
nodes.detail: Native forward/backward kernels integrate with PyTorch training, with gradients compared against reference implementations.

nodes.label: JAX & Flax
nodes.detail: Differentiable geometric operations, recurrent scans and Flax model modules in a separate backend.

nodes.label: GPU profiling
nodes.detail: CPU/CUDA profiling, synchronised timing, warm-up, peak-memory measurements and comparisons of launch and compute costs.

nodes.label: TensorFlow & Keras
nodes.detail: Convolutional image-classification models, tf.data batching/prefetching and validation diagnostics.

nodes.label: Training pipelines
nodes.detail: Deterministic dataset splits, sampled batches, optimiser steps, fixed evaluation batches, checkpoints and structured experiment outputs.

nodes.label: Computer vision & OCR
nodes.detail: Image-classification coursework and Tesseract-based text extraction from scanned pages; preprocessing and diagnostics support both workflows.

nodes.label: Experiment design
nodes.detail: Matched baselines, ablations, held-out cohorts and multiple seeds separate architectural effects from implementation and optimisation effects.

nodes.label: Speech & alignment
nodes.detail: Integrating Whisper-family transcription, audio-to-text matching and generated narration in an audio-enhanced EPUB pipeline under development.

nodes.label: Numerical validation
nodes.detail: Reference-output comparisons, gradient checks, tolerances and streaming equivalence; symbolic and exact arithmetic support the geometric research.

nodes.label: Reproducible research
nodes.detail: Pinned data identities, explicit configurations, validation scripts and artifact manifests keep experiments traceable.

nodes.label: Software & systems
nodes.detail: Java and .NET applications, data work and the engineering practices used to build, debug and release software.

nodes.label: Java
nodes.detail: Event-driven server plugins, commands, custom interfaces and Paper/Bukkit integration.

nodes.label: C# & .NET
nodes.detail: Windows applications and relational data access through WinForms coursework and a WPF utility prototype.

nodes.label: Events & concurrency
nodes.detail: Java plugin events, async process handling, Qt workers and browser Web Workers connect background work to application interfaces.

nodes.label: SQL & data access
nodes.detail: PostgreSQL/Drizzle services and SQLite mobile persistence, alongside SQL Server stored procedures and ADO.NET coursework.

nodes.label: API integration
nodes.detail: Batched external API requests, weather-data validation and caching, speech-service integration and existing server-plugin interfaces.

nodes.label: Document pipelines
nodes.detail: Python PDF-to-EPUB components for fixed and reflowable layouts, OCR, text fragments, embedded narration and SMIL timing; Qt reader interfaces support preview.

nodes.label: Linux
nodes.detail: Server administration, command-line workflows and Linux/WSL development environments.

nodes.label: Data visualisation
nodes.detail: D3 analytics charts, mobile forecast timelines and rainfall-coverage views; Pandas/NumPy and notebook plotting support exploratory analysis.

nodes.label: Git & CI/CD
nodes.detail: Version control, automated release gates, dependency/build checks, SHA-256 manifests and immutable-asset verification.

nodes.label: Automated testing
nodes.detail: Application, database, access-rule and numerical tests, including offline-delivery failure cases, locale-aware inputs and reference-gradient checks.

nodes.label: Debugging & diagnostics
nodes.detail: Using logs, process output, tests and profiling to investigate application failures, server behaviour and computational bottlenecks.

edges: Input and write-boundary checks are exercised by automated tests
Reporting and analysis turn recorded data into useful summaries
Both transform and validate structured records
Profiling guides investigation of computational bottlenecks
Experiment contracts are checked with executable validation
Versioned code and verified artifacts preserve experiment provenance
Python supports tabular analysis and scientific computation
Offline record delivery connects mobile SQLite state to backend persistence
Speech timing connects narration to passages in the generated EPUB
